name: Bello
description: Runs shops in the Gungeon.

name: Ox and Cadence
description: Store clerk and owner of the shop in The Breach.

name: Drunkard
description: Tells stories about the Bosses and the NPCs of The Breach.

name: Tinker
description: In charge of operating and fixing the shortcut elevators.

name: Frifle and the Grey Mauser
description: Hand out hunting quests in The Breach. Quests can be completed to unlock new items.

name: Bowler
description: Allows the player to enter a Rainbow run instead of a normal run.

name: Winchester
description: Runs a shooting range in the Gungeon. Rewards the player with chests of different rarities based on their performance.

name: Gunsling King and Manservantes
description: Issues room challenges in the Gungeon. Rewards players with items upon completion.

name: Ser Manuel
description: Teaches players how to survive the Gungeon. Occasionally appears in secret rooms as Monster Manuel and gifts players an item or gun.

name: Blockner
description: Ser Manuel's rival.

name: Sell Creep
description: Found in shops, takes items and guns and gives shells in return.

name: The Lost Adventurer
description: Rewards players with items for completing the current dungeon map.

name: Ledge Goblin
description: Hangs around a ledge.

name: Blacksmith
description: Runs a shop in the Forge. Collects the ingredients for The Bullet That Can Kill The Past from players.

name: Resourceful Rat
description: Steals the player's items in the Gungeon. Offers up to three free guns if the player has taken a shortcut.

name: Professor Goopton
description: Runs a shop in The Breach and another in the Gungeon.

name: Trorc
description: Runs a shop in The Breach and another in the Gungeon.

name: Old Red
description: Runs a shop in the Gungeon.

name: Cursula
description: Runs a shop in the Gungeon.

name: Flynt
description: Runs a shop in the Gungeon.

name: Doug
description: Runs a shop in The Breach.

name: Sorceress
description: Grants players a blessing for their next run.

name: Tonic
description: Allows the player to toggle Turbo Mode, which increases game speed.

name: Daisuke
description: Enables Challenge Mode for the next run.

name: Patches and Mendy
description: Run the smash tent in the Gungeon. Fully heals the player. Gives the Robot either one Junk, the Bottle, or a piece of armor.

name: Synergrace
description: Runs a shop in the Gungeon where the player can purchase a synergy chest.

name: Vampire
description: Appears in the Gungeon and allows the player to trade half a heart for shells. Gives 20 shells multiplied by the floor's price multiplier for each half heart.

name: Witches
description: Allows the player to exchange a gun for a different gun and 2 curse. The new gun will either be the same quality or one quality higher.

name: Old Man
description: Gifts players one item or a gun. Refuses to give the player an item or gun if playing in co-op.

name: Brother Albern
description: Asks the player a question and rewards them with a pickup, item, or gun.

name: Save Button
description: Option to save and exit at the end of each floor, resuming the run at a later time.

name: Gunknights
description: Guards the entrance to the Gungeon, barring entry to the player until they play (or skip) the tutorial.

name: Circle Knight and Square Knight
description: Stand to the left and right of the Sorceress, protecting her.

name: Union Mimic Chest
description: Can be encountered in the Resourceful Rat's Lair, in the chest room, if the player is wearing the Mimic Tooth Necklace.
